messages:
lucas_finance: Quick question @kate_peopleops  our office had a surprise remote shutdown on Feb 15 for weather and I was scheduled to take 2 PTO days that week (Feb 14-15). Payroll shows both days as used even though the company closed on the 15th. Is there a way to "bank" the 1 day or carry it forward?

kate_peopleops: hi @lucas_finance we can sort this. Two pieces: 1) if the company designated Feb 15 as a company holiday/office closure we don't charge PTO for that date; 2) carryover vs banked hours depends on status (salaried vs hourly) and how you booked the time. Can you confirm whether you submitted PTO for the 15th or only for the 14th+15th?

lucas_finance: I submitted PTO for both days before the closure was announced. Payroll processed before the closure notice went out.

kate_peopleops: ok. Because PTO was booked and payroll closed, we do a retro adjustment instead of an automatic bank. Please file the "Leave Adjustment" form and attach the closure notice (link below) and your original PTO screenshots. Manager sign-off required. If approved we'll restore the 8 hours for Feb 15 back to your balance.

rachel_manager: I can approve this. @lucas_finance please tag me on the form so I get the approval task. We generally approve when the company closure overrides pre-booked PTO.

logan_engineer: quick related Q  for hourly folks can we get "banked hours" instead of PTO carryover? Our payroll team sometimes lets hourly employees bank overtime or comp time.

kate_peopleops: good point @logan_engineer. Policy summary: - Salaried/exempt employees: we restore PTO balances via leave adjustments; no comp time. - Hourly/non-exempt: payroll can sometimes record comp time or banked hours, but it requires payroll+manager approval and must follow local labor rules. If you're hourly, include that in the form and payroll will advise.

kate_peopleops: Process & timing: 1) Submit People Portal -> Leave Adjustment form (People Portal link: https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/leave-adjustment). 2) Manager approves. 3) People Ops validates closure evidence and posts retro adjustment to leave ledger. We target completion within one payroll cycle (usually 10 business days).

lucas_finance: thanks  filed the form and attached screenshots + closure notice. @rachel_manager I tagged you.

rachel_manager: approved in portal. @kate_peopleops FYI I left a note that this overlaps our release blackout on the 16th but that shouldn't matter for an excused closure.

hr-bot: People Ops form "Leave Adjustment" posted: https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/leave-adjustment (auto message).

kate_peopleops: Received the submission. I'll route to payroll and confirm here when the 8 hours are restored. Also FYI: year-end carryover caps still apply; if restoring the hours would put you over the 5-day cap we'll annotate as a company closure exception and work with finance to allow the extra day for this specific case (director sign-off may be required). Expect an update in ~7-10 business days.

lucas_finance: appreciate it, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
